clips.send: Supreme People’s Procuratorate. People’s procuratorates are the state’s organs of legal supervision; the Supreme People’s Procuratorate is the highest. A procuratorate is roughly China’s public prosecutor’s office — with extra supervising duties. It approves arrests and brings criminal cases to court on behalf of the state (public prosecution). A higher procuratorate leads the lower ones.
